m: अर्ब् cl. 1. P. अर्बति (perf. आनर्ब, L.) to go, L.; to hurt, L.
a: अर्ब् — {c1c} P. (अर्बति, आनर्ब, अर्बितुं) 1 To go towards. --2 To kill, hurt.

v: hiMsane BvAdi॰ para॰ saka॰ sew । arba(rva)ti ArbI(rvI)t Ana(rba)rba ।

s: hiMse । (BvAdi-paraM-sakaM-sew .) gatO । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ arbbati । iti durgAdAsaH ॥

puM, klI, (arbba + vic, tasmE udeti, ud + iRa + qa .) daSakowisaMKyA । rogaviSezaH । mAMsakIlaH । mAMsapuruzaH । Av iti BAzA । iti liNgAdisaMgrahe amaro medinI ca ॥ tasya nidAnalakzaRe । “gAtrapradeSe kvacideva dozAH saMmUrcCitA mAMsamasfk pradUzya । vfttaM sTiraM mandarujaM mahAntamanalpamUlaM ciravfdDyapAkaM ॥ kurbbanti mAMsocCrayamatyagADaM tamarbbadaM SAstravido vadanti” । mahAntaM granTyapekzayA cireRa vfdDirapAkaSca yasya tat ciravfdDyapAkaM । apAkamiti granTeH sakASAdasya BedajYApakaM । atyagADaM dUrAnupravizwaM ॥ * ॥ nidAnapUrvvakARi viSizwAni lakzaRAnyAha । “vAtena pittena kaPena vApi raktena mAMsena ca medasA ca । tajjAyate tasya ca lakzaRAni granTeH samAnAni sadA Bavanti” ॥ granTeH samAnAni vAtikapEttikaSlEzmikamedojAnAM granTInAM lakzaRErvvAtikapEttikaSlEzmikamedojAnAmarbbudAnAM lakzaRAni tulyAni Bavanti ॥ * ॥ raktArbbudamAha । “dozapraduzwe ruDiraM SirASca saNkocya saMpIqya tatastvapAkaM । sasrAvamunnahyati mAsapiRqaM mAMsANkurErAvftamASu vfdDiM ॥ sravatyajasraM ruDiraM praduzwamasADyametadruDirAtmakantu । raktakzayopadravapIqitatvAt pARqurBavedarbbudapIqitastu” ॥ dozo'tra pittaM ruDiraM SirASca saNkocya saMpIqya saMhatIkftyamAMsAsfjoH sarvezvarbbudezu dUzyatvaM raktaje tu viSezatorakvaduzwiH । evaM mAMsArbbude viSezato mAMsaduzwirbodDavyA । tato mAMsapiRqamunnahyati udgataM karoti । apAkaM IzatpAkaM yaTA syAdevamiti kriyAviSezaRaM IzatpAkaSca ekadeSapAkena । raktakzayopadravapIqitatvAt । raktakzayopadravAH suSrutenoktAH । tEH pIqitatvAt । arbbudapIqitaH raktArbbudapIqitaH ॥ * ॥ mAMsArbbudasya saMprAptimAha “muzwiprahArAdiBirardite'Nge mAMsaM praduzwaM samupEti SoTaM । avedanaM snigDamananyavarRamapAkamaSmopamamapracAlyaM” ॥ mAMsaM praduzwaM vAtena । avedanaM vedanArahitaM IzadvedanaM vA । apAkaM pAkarahitaM IzatpAkaM vA । aSmopamaM pAzARavat kaWinaM । apracAlyaM sTiraM । yadyapi raktamAMsArbbudayo raktamAMsayorhetutvenoktiH taTApi raktaje pittaM mAMsaje vAyurAramBakaH ॥ * ॥ nidAnamAha । “praduzwamAMsasya narasya gAQametadBavenmAMsaparAyaRasya” । mAMsASanAByAsena yaH praduzwamAMsastasyEva Bavati ityarTaH ॥ * ॥ asADyamAha । “mAMsArbudaM tvetadasADyamAhuH sADyezvapImAni vivarjayecca । saMprastutaM marmmasu yacca jAtaM srotaHsu vA yacca BavedacAlyaM” ॥ sADyezvapi vAtajAdizvapi । imAni vakzyamARAni saMprastutAdIni ॥ * ॥ aparAsADyamAha । “yajjAyate'nyat Kalu pUrvvajAte jYeyaM tadaDyarbbudamarbbudajYEH ॥ yaddvandvajAtaM yugapat kramAdvA dvirarbbudaM tacca BavedasADyaM” ॥ * ॥ arbbudAnAM pAkABAve hetumAha । “na pAkamAyAti kaPADikatvAnmedobahutvAcca viSezatastu । dozasTiratvAt graTanAcca tezAM sarvvArbbudAnyeva nisargatastu” । graTanAt granTirUpatvAt । nanvapacyAM kaPamedasorADikye'pi pAko dfSyate taTAtra kaTaM na pAka ityAha nisargAt svaBAvAt ॥ * ॥ aTArbbudasya cikitsA । “granTyarbbudAnAM na yato viSezaH pradozahetvAkftidozaduzweH । ataScikitsedBizagarbbudAni viDAnavidgranTicikitsitena ॥ haridrA-loDra-pattaNga-gfhaDUma-manaHSilA । maDupragAQo lepo'yaM medo'rbbudaharaH paraH ॥ 1 ॥ mUlakasya kftaH kzAro haridrAyAstaTEva ca । SaNKacUrRena saMyukto lepaH sidDo'rbbudApahaH ॥ 2 ॥ vawadugDakuzWaromakaliptaM badDaM vawasya patreRa । aDyasTisaptarAtrAt mahAdapyupaSAntimarbbudaM gacCet ॥ 3 ॥ SigrumUlakayorbbIjaM rakzoGnaM surasAM yavaM । takreRASvaripuM pizwvA limpedarbbudaSAntaye ॥ 4 ॥ rakzoGnaM sarzapaM । surasAM tulasIM । yavaM randrayavaM । aSvaripuM karavIraM । ityarbbudADikAraH । iti BAvaprakASaH ॥

m: अर्बुध m. = अर्बुद m. above, Kāṭh.; Anukr.
अर्बुदाकार m. ‘shaped like a tumour’, the plant Cordia Myxa, L.
अर्बुदारण्य n. N. of a forest, NarasP.

v: na॰ arba (rva) vic tasmE udeti ud + iR--qa । (Av iti) KyAte 1 mAMsapiRqAkAre rogaBede, sa ca suSrutoktavartmASrayezuekaviMSatirogezu maDyerogaBedaH “pfTagdozA samastASca yadA vartma vyapASrayAH । sirA vyApyAvatizWante vartmasvaDikamUrcCitAH । vivardDya mAMsaM raktaYca tadA vartmavyApASrayAn । vikArAn janayatyASu nAmatastAn niboData” ityupakramya utsarddinopraBftIn ekaviMSati BedAn uktvA tezAM pratyekalakzaRAnyuktAni tatra॰ “vartmAntarasTaM vizamaM granTiBUtamavedanam । vijYeyamarbudaM puMsAM saraktamavalambitam” ityarvudalakzmoktam arbudaYca nAnAviDaM mAMsArvudarSoRitArvudAdiBedAt । “kfzRasPowIsaraktESca piqakABiSca pIqitam । yasya vastirujaScogrA jYeyaM tacCoRitArbudam । mAMsadozeRa jAnIyAdarbudaM mAMsasamBavam” evaM medo'rbudAdayo'zi tatroktA rogaBedA jYeyAH । 2 daSakowisaMKyAyAM 3 tatsaMKyAtezuma ekAdikowisaMKyA daSagfRottarA uktvA arbudamavajaM KarvaniKarvamahApadmaSaNkzavastasmAt” lIlA॰ “imA me'gna! izwakA DenavaHsantvekA ca daSa ca daSa ca SataM ca SataM cetyupakramya “arbudaM canyarbudaYca iti yaju॰ 17, 2 । 4 parvvataBede 5 asuraBede ca pu॰ । “mahAntaM cidarbudaM nikramI padA” f॰ 1, 51, 4, 6 kAdraveye sarpaBede pu॰ paYcame'hanItyupa'kramya “arbudaH kAdraveyo rAjetyAha tasya sarpAviSaH” iti Sata॰ brA॰ । ambUni dadAti dA--ka vede masya raH । 7 meGe “nyarbudaM vAvfDAno aguH f॰ 2, 11, 20, “ambUni dadAtItyarbudo meGaH” BA॰ arbudAkAratvAt garBasya 8 mAMsapiRqaBede” “yadi piRqaH pumAn, strI cetpeSI, napuMsake'rbudamiti” suSru॰ dvitIyamAsikagarBamAtre na॰ “praTame mAsi saMkledaBUto DAtuvimUrcCitaH । mAsyarbudaM dvitIye tu tftIye'NgendriyEryutaH” yA॰ smf॰ “dvitIye tu mAsi arbudamIzatkaWinaM mAMsapiRqamayaM Bavati” mitA॰ ।
m: अर्बुद m. Ved. a serpent-like demon (conquered by Indra, a descendant of Kadrū therefore called Kādraveya, ŚBr.; AitBr.; said to be the author of RV. x, 94; RAnukr.), RV. &c.
अर्बुद (अस्), m. id., RV. i, 51, 6 and x, 67, 12
अर्बुद (अम्), n. N. of the above-named hymn, RV. x, 94; ĀśvŚr.
अर्बुद (अस्, अम्), m. n. a long round mass (said especially of the shape of the foetus in the second half of the first month [Nir. xiv, 6] or in the second month [Yājñ. iii, 75 and 89])
a swelling, tumour, polypus, Suśr. &c.
अर्बुद the cartilage of a rib, Viṣṇ.
(अर्बुद), n. (also m., L.) ten millions, VS. xvii, 2, &c. (or 100 millions, See महार्बुद)
(अस्), (अस्), m. N. of a mountain in the west of India (commonly called Abū, a place of pilgrimage of the Jainas, and celebrated for its Jaina temples)
(आस्), (आस्), m. pl. N. of a people, VarBṛS.; BhP. &c.
अर्बुद (with Buddhists) N. of one of the 8 cold hells, Dharmas. 122
a: अर्बु(र्वु)दः, --दं — 1 A swelling, tumour, (of various kinds); मांस˚, नासा˚, शोणित˚ &c. --2 One hundred millions. --3 N. of a mountain in the west of India (Abu). --4 A serpent-like demon killed by Indra. --5 A serpent. --6 A cloud. --7 A place of pilgrimage (of the Jainas). --8 A long round mass, lump of flesh; यदि पिंडः पुमान्स्त्री चेत् पेशी नपुंसकं चेदर्बुदं Suśr; Y. 3. 75, 89 (मांसपिंड). --9 N. of a people. --10 N. of a hell.

m: अर्बुद—धा ind. millionfold, JaimUp.
अर्बुद—शिखर m. id., Hit.
अर्बुद—माहात्म्य n. N. of a ch. of the SkandaP.
अर्बुद—पर्वत m. the mountain Arbuda.

v: pu॰ arbudamivAcarati arbuda + kvip in । sarvvavyApake ISAne । “arbudirnAma yodevaISAnaSca nyarbudiH । yAByAmantarikzamAvftamiyaM ca pfTivI mahI” aTa॰ 11, 9, 4 ।
m: अर्बुदि m. a serpent like demon (probably = अर्बुद and अर्बुद m. above, but called इन्द्रमेधिन्, q.v.), AV. xi, 9 and 10 (in almost every verse) (cf. न्य्-अर्बुदि.)
a: अर्बुदिः — 1 A serpent-like demon conquered by Indra. --2 All-pervading lord.

m: अर्बुदिन् mfn. afflicted with a swelling or tumour, Suśr.
a: अर्बुदिन् — a. Afflicted with swelling or tumour.

m: अर्बु—˚दोदासर्पिणी f. ‘creeping near of Arbuda’, N. of a partic. sacrificial path, AitBr.
अर्बुक m. pl. N. of a people, MBh. ii, 1119.
